- "No": Wins if Nathaniel Brown registers 0 shots on target during the same match under the same conditions, or if he does not appear on the pitch at any point during regular time or stoppage time.

- A shot is counted as "on target" if it is on frame and requires a save or results in a goal; blocked shots that do not reach the goalkeeper's line are excluded per standard football shot-on-target definitions.
